title: Turán's pure power-sum constant C42, upper bound (first-block cut-off tau >= 1/3)
statement: Give the inputs of the finite-step criterion in section 2 of Pinho's paper (Griego's construction with M middle steps): alpha = a + ib with a > 0, breaks tau = t_0 < ... < t_M = 1 - tau with tau >= 1/3, middle values eta_j and C. If |1 - alpha| < C, every |eta_j| < C and |Y| < C D (I and J integrals as defined there), then C42 <= C. The checker verifies all of it exactly; the asymptotic reduction itself is unrefereed. The best value on the page, 0.6873358063 (Koshta, tau = 41/200), uses three- and four-fold terms that this checker does not evaluate; the best with tau >= 1/3 is Pinho's 0.6888863712.
submission: JSON in Pinho's layout: {"C": decimal or p/q, "alpha": [re, im], "breaks": [p/q, ...], "eta": [[re, im], ...]} (exact decimals or fractions), or Griego's layout ({"bound", "alpha": {re, im}, "tau", "eta": {re, im}}).

provenance.keeper: T. Tao et al., optimization constants repository (teorth/optimizationproblems)
provenance.revision: main branch as named in the source

score: a certified upper bound on the constant (exact; smaller is better)
